front: CloudFront or Global Accelerator: a game sends UDP traffic to two Regions, and partners need fixed IP addresses. Which one do you choose?
extra: Global Accelerator fits non-HTTP traffic such as [gaming (UDP), IoT (MQTT), or Voice over IP](../facts/global-accelerator.md#global-accelerator-faq-good-fit-non-http-static-ip-fast-failover).
